config.promotionGate: Set before games: at least6/8 points, zero technical failures, independent rule/tactical/sanitizer tests, and full production integration checks. Otherwise keep baseline. This is a conservative engineering gate, not a significance test.
config.clock: Projection, sampling, IPC, native search, deadline stop and process exit included. Readiness excluded for both; no overlapping searches.
config.information: Only current side publicState with its private captures; no real hidden allocation or setup seed sent to either engine.
config.draws: Public-position threefold or120 quiet plies. 400 ply cap explicitly unresolved.
config.limits: Four pairs at400ms, exploratory only; not an Elo estimate or replication of previous Pika matches.
